license_note: Original, concise art-direction presets; no third-party prompt corpus or copyrighted gallery images copied.

profiles.description: Premium grounded 3D hero prop look development
guidance: Use a controlled studio key and fill light with believable metal, wood or stone roughness and restrained highlights.
Keep the physical silhouette clear at a gameplay-relevant size; show only the declared components.
Maintain a stable camera and neutral supporting background, never fabricate hidden reverse-side or internal details.

profiles.description: Clean technical-facing visual sheet for 3D model reference
guidance: Use the requested orthographic or explicitly approved view; avoid unexpected perspective and foreshortening.
Prioritize consistent outer contour, visible component placement and readable interfaces.
Do not turn incomplete single-view evidence into invented dimensional or hidden engineering claims.

profiles.description: Subordinate game environment background with readable gameplay foreground
guidance: Use restrained material detail and value contrast so interactive props remain legible.
Keep broad lighting, surface grain scale and perspective coherent with approved gameplay camera.
Avoid attention-grabbing invented objects, fake UI, readable text and unnecessary baked shadows.
Prioritize clear silhouette, consistent stroke/edge language and legibility at actual UI size.
Separate image artwork from editable code-native interface text; avoid unintended lettering.
Keep edges clean and verify transparency when output specification requires it.

profiles.description: Consistent 2D game art and animation frames
guidance: Preserve character/object identity, palette, silhouette and apparent volume across frames.
Keep intended facing, pivot and frame boundaries stable; do not add extra characters.
Specify pixel-grid and palette discipline only when the user actually requests pixel art.

profiles.description: Material appearance reference for a 3D game asset
guidance: Describe surface material response, wear distribution, roughness, specular character and microdetail at believable scale.
Do not invent normals, topology, UV layout or numeric PBR parameter values from a color photograph.
Preserve physical identity and approved material region boundaries.
